articles.summary: Claude Managed Agents gives an agent a sandbox, a credential vault, and a schedule. It does not give it a browser. Here is why the web outside the sandbox is a structurally different problem, how the vault hands over a key without handing over the key, and what a Notte persona can finish that a browser alone cannot.
articles.title: Claude Managed Agents x Notte: What the Sandbox Can't Reach

articles.summary: Coshell ships a localhost browser that answers one question: does it render? Every other question lives outside the sandbox. Here is why a coding agent needs a second browser, who gets to step into it, and what a Notte persona can finish that an inbox alone cannot.
articles.title: Coshell x Notte: What a Coding Agent Can't Learn from Localhost
